name: Perfect Thrust
description: Adds a ring around the crosshair while charging an attack. It marks the moment letting go counts as a heavy attack and signals READY once every charge-dependent effect, such as the Thrust and Slow and Steady blessings, weapon windup bonuses or the Ogryn talent Crunch!, has reached its maximum stacks; without such effects, READY marks the heavy attack itself. While aiming down sights, it also signals READY once the ranged blessings Surgical and Pinpointing Target have reached their maximum stacks.
author: LucLeto
